action: Organisations that send email through Cuenote FC: ask Ymir Link which of your lists were taken, assess whether you must notify recipients, and warn them about fake emails. Recipients: be cautious of unexpected messages from brands you subscribe to.
exec: A breach at an email-sending supplier exposed its customers' mailing lists at large scale, which may create notification duties for them.
plain: Japanese email-delivery company Ymir Link confirmed that attackers took about 47.9 million mailing records from 49 systems of its Cuenote FC service, updating a break-in first disclosed on October 19.
summary: In an update to an intrusion first disclosed October 19, the email-delivery provider confirmed attackers extracted about 47.9 million distribution records from 49 systems. It is part of a run of large Japanese data leaks this autumn that also includes Arara, SEGA and Nitori.
title: Ymir Link confirms 47.9 million email records taken from Cuenote FC

validation.note: One research blog citing the company's update.
